connector.name: Figuard MCP
connector.registryDescription: Pre-flight spend authorization for AI agents. Set a budget, enforce limits, audit every decision.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package figuard-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the figuard account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FIGUARD_API_KEY
env.description: FiGuard API key — set this (with FIGUARD_BASE_URL) to use a self-hosted FiGuard server. Leave unset to run embedded: in-process enforcement against a local SQLite file, no account or server needed.

env.name: FIGUARD_BASE_URL
env.description: Self-hosted FiGuard server URL. Leave unset to run embedded against a local SQLite file.

env.name: FIGUARD_DATABASE
env.description: Path to the embedded SQLite file (default ~/.figuard/figuard.db). Embedded is the default backend — no server required.

env.name: FIGUARD_MODE
env.description: Backend mode: embedded | server | sandbox. Defaults to embedded when nothing else is configured.
